notes.title: Future updates and improvements.
notes.content:
Hey folks!

In this post we gonna discuss new possible updates and improvements for Spooky Chase!
[h2]Custom Controls[/h2]

- This has been our main feedback and will be the next update.

[h2]New improvements and modes for Multiplayer:[/h2]

- We want to add 2 extra stages on each scenario (Graveyard, Haunted Castle, etc.) alongside with a new "tournament" system.

Also, new game modes to choose such as: Paint Battle and Flag Hunt.

Feedbacks and suggestions are always welcome!

[h2]New stages and Medals for Endless Mode:[/h2]

- We been working on new stages to add to Endless Mode alongside with a medal system (Bronze, Silver and Gold) to show for your friends who's best.

[h2]Consoles Launch:[/h2]

- Spooky Chase will be released at beginning of 2021 on Nintendo Switch, XBOX One and PS4.

[h2]Support us:[/h2]

- For all this updates come true, we need your help to spread the word of Spooky Chase! Share the game with your friends, write your review in the game page, record your gameplay. This helps us a lot to reach more people and continue to work on our game.

Don't forget to like and comment, your feedback means a lot for us! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

After listen some feedback, we start working in a few ajustments to the game.

The game now has a higher base volume and the campaign have some hints in each stage you enter.

Next update will have a customization option for keyboard and controller.

Got any feedback for us? Please let we know in the comments!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
In this upgrade, we are improving the user experience by doing some adjustments to the game.

- First Golden Balloon - 

We add a little text explaining the use of the Golden Balloon. Also, we move it to the middle of the stage to give new players a little help.

- Enemy respawn mark - 

It now shows a purple mark where the enemies spawns before you starts moving. 

- Improve the player's hitbox -

Now enemies can't kill you from below (except Ghosts).

- Quick Hints before entering the stages -

You receive a hint for each stage in the game.

- Better "New Stage Unlocked" menu - 

By collecting the enough flags, the game will ask you if you want to proceed to the next stage. This gives a better feedback for new players who are stuck in the firsts levels, thinking they needed to collect all the flags to progressing the game.

- Dead Knight color change -

The Dead Knight now is red to gives a better contrast to the brown stage.

- Other adjustments - 

Score Grave speed is now faster.

Bug fix.
